name: National comprehensive wealth per capita index (real chained 2019 US$)
sourceNote: Total wealth is calculated as the sum of produced capital, natural capital, human capital, and net foreign assets.  Values are measured at market exchange rates in constant 2018 US dollars, using a country-specific GDP deflator.
sourceOrganization: World Bank. 2021. The Changing Wealth of Nations 2021: Managing Assets for the Future. Washington, DC: World Bank. doi:10.1596/978-1-4648-1590-4.
